course.title: Electrical Outlet Installation & Basics
course.description: An introductory course exploring household electrical outlets, outlet installation contexts, cable and circuit concepts, and basic electrical safety. This course is for awareness and learning only; it does not qualify learners to perform electrical work.
learningOutcomes: Recognize common household electrical outlet types and their intended uses.
Understand the broad stages and considerations involved in adding an outlet to an existing or unfinished wall.
Identify why circuit capacity, protective devices, grounding, and local electrical codes matter.
Recognize when electrical work must be assessed and completed by a qualified electrician.
skills: Recognizing when professional assistance is required
course.safetyNotice: Electrical installation and testing can cause electric shock, burns, fire, or death. Do not attempt wiring, live testing, panel work, or outlet installation based on these videos. Practical work must be performed by a qualified electrician in accordance with applicable local codes and safety procedures.

Identify why this work requires a qualified electrician.

learningObjectives: Recognize that EV charging outlets can require dedicated higher-capacity circuits.

Know that this type of installation must be assessed and completed by a qualified electrician.
